1v2 against two Apex AIs in G1-H6 (one plays Armada: a Pawn came at 2:40). They raid our home with single Pawns, Grunts and Ticks. Towers answer the single raiders, the army stays one body, the economy grows behind the towers.

RAIDS: a party of three or more at our extractors, constructors, solars or plant is the Incisor body's business first, whatever it was doing; it fights them there whole and goes back to its course when they are dead or gone. A lone raider is the Guards' and the commander's, never a reason for the body to split.

commander: plays its list. It stays at home, guards the vehicle plant at low priority and builds solars there when the energy line reads STALLING. It fights and D-guns raiders that come into our base. It never walks toward a party that outweighs it; then it goes home beside the plant.

constructors: play their lists. A constructor that is hit walks home to the commander. A lost extractor is rebuilt the minute the raider is gone.

plant_5718: plays its list; never idle.

The Rascal group (group_A, corfav): roves now, alone, to find both Apex bases; it never follows the commander.

The Incisor group (corgator, later Brutes): one body. While it has fewer than six Incisors it holds at spot_61 and kills parties that enter our half. With six or more Incisors and no party of three or more in our half, it fights to spot_71, then spot_78, then spot_75, then spot_70, killing extractors and constructors, keeping out of turret reach, never splitting off detachments to chase single raiders; new soldiers walk to it. Against a party that outweighs it, it walks to spot_61 and holds there.
